is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus s.l. (page 1, 9, 10).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for Vgsc L1014S (kdr-East) in An. gambiae s.l. (page 12, 13, Table 6).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 6 provides genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) for An. gambiae s.s., An. arabiensis, and pooled An. gambiae s.l. (page 13).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from 20 hamlets in Muheza District, Tanzania (page 2, 10).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical baseline survey conducted in 2019 (page 2, 15).

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is provided for 20 specific hamlets in Muheza District, Tanzania (page 6, Table 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted between May and August 2019 (page 5, 15).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study is a baseline survey for a specific cRCT (Kisinza et al. 2025) and represents a new, independent collection.

supplement.evidence: The required genotype counts are provided in Table 6 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This baseline study in Muheza District, Tanzania, characterized malaria burden and insecticide resistance in Anopheles vectors. It reports high pyrethroid resistance and provides genotype counts for the kdr-East (L1014S) mutation in An. gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae s.s. and An. arabiensis), including separate counts for survivors and dead mosquitoes from WHO bioassays.
